name: Dalyria
backstory:
Prior to being spawn, she was a doctor, Physician General to the Parliament of Baldur's Gate. She believes that vampirism can be cured as any other disease can, and so sought youthful blood to try to overwhelm the vampirism infection. 

She sought Leon's daughter, Victoria, brought her to the Szarr Palace and bit into her. However, Leon had placed a curse on Victoria as a means of protection, which was triggered when she was bitten. Cazador then found Dalyria, who was retching in reaction to tasting cursed blood, and dragged her away for disobeying the rules and drinking a thinking creature.
